Synopsis:
A lower city denizen visits the Guildhall for a drink with his friend. In truth, he's being fed drink by this sober friend to keep him out of trouble. But he knows where to listen, and has learned the location of the Stone Lord's ambush. We can learn it from him if we put up with his shit long enough.

Phostlethwaite is actually sober and pretending to be drunk at Nine‑Fingers’ request so Tut won’t run off and cause trouble; he quietly warns the player not to drag his name into anything. Tut is loud, vulgar and given to belching, but he does know where the Guild intends to ambush the Stone Lord — the Counting House — and relishes Nine‑Fingers’ plan. context: The scene takes place in Nine‑Fingers Keene’s Guildhall in the Lower City, where the player encounters Tut Thistlebog — loud, vulgar, and thoroughly drunk — propped up by his companion Phostlethwaite. Phostlethwaite is actually sober (he’s feigning drunkenness at Nine‑Fingers’ request) and quietly warns the player not to drag his name into anything; he’s keeping Tut occupied because Tut might otherwise run off or cause trouble. Tut, however, knows where the Guild intends to ambush the Stone Lord — the Counting House — and delights in the plan. Jaheira and Nine‑Fingers are present or nearby, and Zhent mercenaries are in the Guildhall supporting Nine‑Fingers, so learning the ambush location requires putting up with Tut’s nonsense (or bribing/indulging him).
